description: This file contains utility PHP functions related to session handling, string manipulation, parameter extraction from device management paths, encryption mapping, PSM mode notifications, and configuration file parsing. It appears to support device management and network configuration tasks within a larger web-based gateway management system.

methods.name: php_getstr
methods.description: Wraps getStr with PSM mode session check, filtering out WiFi and MoCA related strings if PSM is enabled.

methods.name: php_getinstanceids
methods.description: Wraps getInstanceIds with PSM mode session check, filtering out WiFi and MoCA related strings if PSM is enabled.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Executes DmExtGetStrsWithRootObj and processes the result into a key-value associative array.

methods.name: encrypt_map
methods.description: Maps encryption mode and method to a human-readable encryption type string.

methods.name: getLeafName
methods.description: Extracts the leaf element name from a full device management parameter path.

methods.name: getObjIdInPath
methods.description: Extracts the object ID portion from a device management path.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Retrieves multiple parameter values from device management root and returns an array of dictionaries keyed by parameter name.

methods.name: init_psmMode
methods.description: Generates HTML content to show a notification if the system is in PSM mode, indicating limited information display.

methods.name: php_str_and
methods.description: Performs a bitwise AND of two hexadecimal strings, limited to 32 bits.

methods.name: array_trim
methods.description: Removes leading/trailing whitespace and empty elements from an array.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Reads a configuration XML file to extract default values for given parameter names.
